global_exposure_method: Seven barycentric surface points per actual triangle plus vertices; rays in8 directions against all other relevant triangles. Shared tissue regions use unique source triangles. No arbitrary percentage acceptance threshold; small exposure still requires exact pixel readability.
limitations: Surface intersection and sampled ray exposure are diagnostics, not independent approval. Required detail pixels and all eight actual final views must still be inspected.
